gameRules.packing: Finite pieces translated on integer anchors and quarter-turned inside irregular cell-union boxes. Edge contact is legal; positive-area overlaps and wall intersections are rejected.
gameRules.extraction: Each marked piece independently sweeps its full straight path through a finite aperture against the same remaining fixed pieces. No teleport, removal order, hidden target pose or rotation during extraction.
gameRules.check: Fresh geometry and all required exits decide CHECK. Four failed checks lose; a correct fourth check after three failures wins. No countdown deadline.
gameRules.input: Own input data values, admitted dt, fresh-edge arbitration and cancellation/neutral rearm are covered by the actual Node TAP and frozen full-pair audit.
